--- /dev/null
+++ b/jsonschema/tests/test_legacy_unevaluated_refs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+import pytest
+from referencing import Registry
+
+from jsonschema import Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator, validators
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator", [Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["properties", "items"])
+def test_legacy_references_contribute_evaluation_coverage(Validator, kind):
+    root = "https://example.test/root"
+    outer = "https://example.test/nested/outer"
+    leaf = "https://example.test/nested/leaf"
+    if kind == "properties":
+        coverage = {"properties": {"known": {"type": "integer"}}}
+        schema = {"$ref": outer, "unevaluatedProperties": False}
+        valid = {"known": 1}
+        extra = {"known": 1, "extra": 2}
+        invalid = {"known": "bad"}
+        aggregate = "unevaluatedProperties"
+    else:
+        keyword = "items" if Validator is Draft201909Validator else "prefixItems"
+        coverage = {keyword: [{"type": "integer"}]}
+        schema = {"$ref": outer, "unevaluatedItems": False}
+        valid = [1]
+        extra = [1, 2]
+        invalid = ["bad"]
+        aggregate = "unevaluatedItems"
+    store = {outer: {"$ref": "leaf"}, leaf: coverage}
+    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
+        resolver = validators.RefResolver(root, schema, store=store)
+    validator = Validator(schema, resolver=resolver, registry=Registry())
+    assert list(validator.iter_errors(valid)) == []
+    errors = list(validator.iter_errors(extra))
+    assert [error.validator for error in errors] == [aggregate]
+    errors = list(validator.iter_errors(invalid))
+    assert any(error.validator == "type" for error in errors)
+    assert not validator.is_valid(extra)
+    assert validator.is_valid(valid)

spec.question: Make evaluation coverage honor an explicitly supplied legacy `RefResolver` when `$ref` is used with `unevaluatedItems` or `unevaluatedProperties`, for both Draft 2019-09 and Draft 2020-12. Coverage must come from the same referenced schemas used by ordinary validation, including chains containing relative references resolved against the referenced document's scope. A schema found only in the legacy resolver's store must not require retrieval through the modern registry. Preserve existing behavior when no legacy resolver is supplied, and preserve the two drafts' different item-coverage rules. Return a unified diff against production files only; do not change tests.
